_meta.notes: Weather state machine configuration: clear, rain, and thunderstorm phases, transitions, and environmental impacts per DESIGN.md Part 5 T07.

clear_duration_min_s.notes: Minimum duration of clear weather in seconds

clear_duration_max_s.notes: Maximum duration of clear weather in seconds

rain_duration_min_s.notes: Minimum duration of rain in seconds

rain_duration_max_s.notes: Maximum duration of rain in seconds

storm_telegraph_duration_s.notes: Duration of thunderstorm telegraph phase in seconds

storm_active_duration_s.notes: Duration of thunderstorm active phase in seconds

storm_aftermath_duration_s.notes: Duration of thunderstorm aftermath phase in seconds

rain_moisture_gain_per_s.notes: Moisture deposited to soil tiles per second during rain

storm_moisture_gain_per_s.notes: Moisture deposited to soil tiles per second during active thunderstorm

clear_light_multiplier.notes: Ambient daylight multiplier during clear weather

storm_light_multiplier.notes: Ambient daylight multiplier during active storm

storm_wind_damage_threshold.notes: Wind force threshold above which unreinforced canopy nodes suffer damage

storm_wind_damage_rate.notes: Damage per second applied to vulnerable exposed canopy nodes during active storm

lightning_frequency_per_minute.notes: Average lightning strikes per minute during active thunderstorm

lightning_damage_radius.notes: Radial damage impact of a lightning strike on ground or high canopy

lightning_damage_amount.notes: Base damage dealt to nodes caught in a lightning strike radius

forecast_window_s.notes: How far in advance players can read the weather forecast

biome_weather_modifier.notes: Biome modifier (constant 1.0 in MVP per DESIGN.md)
